verses: A Ma῾alot Poem of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to dwell together in unity!
It is like the precious ointment upon the head, running down upon the beard, the beard of Aharon: running down over the hem of his garments:
like the dew of Ḥermon descending upon the mountains of Żiyyon: for there the Lord has commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.
